works.title: Amazon FBA Growth & Data Analytics
works.summary: Leveraging market-leading tools to manage high-volume inventory and algorithmic pricing.
works.description: Led data-driven operations for an Amazon FBA company (Lanstar). I specialized in using historical data to predict market trends and automated pricing to maintain a competitive edge. My focus was on balancing sales velocity with high profit margins through precise inventory control.
results: Used Keepa & AZ Insight to identify price elasticity and competitive entry points.
Managed complex supply chains in RestockPro to maintain 99%+ in-stock rates.
Deployed ChannelMax for real-time algorithmic repricing, maximizing Buy Box ownership.

works.title: Search Engine & Email Growth Strategy
works.summary: Driving organic traffic and customer retention through SEO and automated email flows.
works.description: Executed full-funnel digital marketing strategies to increase brand visibility and repeat purchases. This involved technical SEO audits to rank for high-intent keywords and the creation of automated email marketing systems to nurture leads and recover abandoned revenue.
results: Optimized on-page SEO and metadata to improve organic search rankings for core product categories.
Developed automated email 'flows' in Klaviyo, increasing revenue from abandoned carts by 15%.
Managed social media content calendars to drive engagement and qualified traffic to storefronts.

works.title: Shopify B2B Conversion Strategy
works.summary: Bridging the gap between technical dental equipment and high-converting e-commerce.
works.description: Strategizing for B2B e-commerce environments to drive lead generation and recurring revenue. By combining UX improvements with conversion rate optimization (CRO), I focus on making high-ticket items and daily clinical supplies easily accessible to professionals.
results: Strategized B2B 'Request a Quote' flows for specialized dental hardware and operatory furniture.
Optimized Shopify 'Online Store 2.0' themes for speed and mobile responsiveness.
Utilized Heatmaps and session recordings to identify and remove friction points in the checkout process.
